name: פִּישׁוֹן
summary: Pishon is the first of the four river branches of Eden, identified by its course around the whole land of Havilah. Its etymology is uncertain.

evidence.note: שֵׁם הָאֶחָד פִּישׁוֹן names the first branch, and the following clause traces its course around Havilah.

note: Moved from the former word entry `ppiyxwon`. The old root key פישונ recorded the consonants of the river name. Its etymology is uncertain.
